summary: surface_context wiring for George chat verified end-to-end. Backend: 3/3 pytest cases green — endpoint accepts surface_context, George names Margaret and cites specific counts + recent-action reason without asking 'which member?', and backward-compat (no surface_context) still returns a valid SSE stream. Frontend: found and fixed one blocking bug (surface_context was silently dropped by the sheet), then re-verified end-to-end via Playwright — initial POST body now contains the full 1997-byte surface_context payload (surface=member_profile, member.display_name=Margaret, member.id=7452ce79-…, counts.reports_open=10, warnings=1, notes=1, 6 recent_actions). George's reply started with 'Margaret has had a bit of attention recently. She's received…' — no clarifying question. Knowledge page (no surface wiring) opens without crashing.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED. The initial-message useEffect called `send(initialMessage, initialContext)` but `send(message: string)` only accepted one argument, so the surface_context payload was silently dropped and every /api/george/chat POST body was `{message, scope:'mcgs'}` with no surface_context. Wire was missing between AskGeorgeBar → AskGeorgeSheet.send() → askGeorge(). Fixed by widening send() to `send(message, surfaceContext?)` and passing it as askGeorge's 4th arg. Re-tested via Playwright: POST body now 1997 bytes including full surface_context.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_george_surface_context.py — 3 tests, ~20s runtime. Auth via POST /api/cms/auth/login. The SSE reader in this test file parses `event:`/`data:` frames and can be reused for any streamed George endpoint. For the AskGeorge frontend, target `summary[aria-label="Ask George about this member"]` to open the disclosure menu, then click a prompt via `page.get_by_text(prompt_text, exact=True)`. To assert follow-up POSTs, wait for the sheet's Send button to lose its 'Stop' label before pressing Enter, otherwise the send is silently blocked by `if (busy) return` in send().
rca_of_issue: Root cause: signature mismatch in AskGeorgeSheet.tsx. The useEffect at line 87 was written for the new API (`send(initialMessage, initialContext)`), but `send()` was still the pre-slice single-arg function. JavaScript silently dropped the extra argument, so surface_context never left the browser. Reproduction: open a member profile, click Ask George → the /api/george/chat POST body was `{message, scope}` (~87 bytes). Fix: extend send() to accept `surfaceContext?` and pass it as askGeorge's 4th positional arg. After fix, the POST body includes surface_context (~2 KB) and George answers immediately without asking to identify the member. Mitigation: the follow-up turn correctly omits surface_context because send() is called with only one argument from the composer path — matches the design intent that context is one-shot on the first turn.
